## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm run check` passes
- [ ] An entry under `Unreleased` in `CHANGELOG.md`, if a package changes
- [ ] Snapshot changes inspected, not just updated
- [ ] Docs and locale files updated in both English and Chinese, if user-facing
- [ ] Screenshots attached, if it changes how a character or a page looks
- [ ] Commits signed off (`git commit -s`); the work is mine or under a license compatible with MIT
